issues.description: The problem statement is inconsistent about the type of the Farm.animal collection: the UML in the statement declares animals as List<Animal>, but the Part 3 text explicitly requires using a Set implemented with HashSet to ensure uniqueness. The template Farm.java does not provide the animals attribute (TODO) and the provided solution uses a List/ArrayList for animals. This mismatch (UML vs. textual requirements vs. solution/template) can confuse students about whether to implement a List or a Set, and whether duplicates must be prevented.
issues.suggestedFix: Resolve the collection type inconsistency: either (A) update the UML and textual description to require a List/ArrayList (and remove the uniqueness/HashSet requirement), or (B) update the template and solution to use Set<Animal> (initialized as new HashSet<>()) and adjust addAnimal/iteration accordingly. Ensure the problem statement, template, and solution all consistently state and use the same collection type and whether duplicates are allowed.
